prompt: Stop-motion paper-cutout animation. The layered paper scene of the spring steppe with yurts, the elder and the children gently lifts, slides and re-cuts itself, piece by piece, into a nineteenth-century schoolroom in a Kazakh steppe town: pale paper walls, tall windows with the steppe outside, a dark blackboard, wooden desks with Kazakh boys in simple chapans holding slates, and a Kazakh teacher in a dark frock coat standing by the blackboard. Smooth continuous metamorphosis of cut paper shapes with soft shadows between layers, calm and elegant, fixed camera, no flashes, no text, no letters.
